1.12.2.1.9.0:
NOTE: Essential is no longer required as a dependency.
You can uninstall it if you don't want it (delete the "essential" folder in the Minecraft folder). If it comes back, another mod probably depends on it.
This should result in improved loading times and better performance.
Additions:
  Added update checking. Can be disabled in Forge's settings
  Added option to disable the effects of night vision
  Added DE QWERTZ keyboard layout support on Linux
Fixes:
  Fixed Compact Chat scrolling the messages when a new message is compacted
  Fixed screenshots getting deleted if making them favorite fails
Misc:
  You can now open the configuration GUI from the mod list
  The startup time notification is now more accurate
  Changed to query the GitHub repository for mod data instead of sk1er.club
1.12.2.1.8.9:
Fixes:
  Resolve not being able to launch the game
Misc:
  Change "safe chat clicks history" to not depend on "safe chat clicks"
1.12.2.1.8.8:
Additions:
  Add cactus to 1.14+ crop hitboxes
  Add option to remove vertical view bobbing
Fixes:
  Resolve achievement menu breaking with remove container background
  Resolve resource pack folder sometimes not opening on windows
  Resolve not being able to open chests with a block 2 blocks above it
  Resolve image preview breaking on Imgur links
Misc:
  Change "inventoryscale" command to be hidden from autocomplete (this command was moved to "/patcher invscale")
  Fixed patcher not working in dev environments
